terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These general terms explain the basic conditions for using the TIX Studio website. They are not a substitute for a separate written agreement for an individual project.

acceptance.title: Introduction and acceptance
acceptance.body: By using this website, you agree to use it lawfully and respectfully and to follow these general terms. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the website. A project engagement may include additional terms agreed in a proposal, quotation, statement of work, or other written agreement.

use.title: Website use and permitted conduct
use.body: You may browse the website and contact TIX for legitimate business or informational purposes. Do not attempt to gain unauthorized access, interfere with the website, submit malicious or unlawful material, impersonate another person, or use the website to infringe another person’s rights.

services.title: Services and project information
services.body: The website presents examples of creative, marketing, production, branding, and digital services. Descriptions and examples are general information, not a promise that a particular service, result, availability, timeline, or deliverable will be provided. Project scope is confirmed separately.

proposals.title: Proposals, quotations, and agreements
proposals.body: A project proposal or quotation may define the requested work, deliverables, timing, fees, approvals, revisions, usage rights, and responsibilities. Those project-specific terms become applicable only when accepted through the process stated in that document or in another written agreement between the parties.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual property and ownership
intellectualProperty.body: Website text, design, images, videos, logos, and other materials belong to TIX or the relevant rights holder unless stated otherwise. You may not copy, modify, publish, sell, or commercially exploit them without permission. Ownership and usage rights for project deliverables are determined by the applicable project agreement and any third-party rights.

submittedMaterials.title: User-submitted materials and content
submittedMaterials.body: When you send information or files through the contact form or another agreed channel, you confirm that you have the right to share them for the purpose of discussing your enquiry. Do not submit confidential material unless the parties have agreed how it should be handled. You remain responsible for the legality and accuracy of what you submit.

thirdParty.title: Third-party websites and services
thirdParty.body: The website may link to social platforms or other third-party websites. TIX does not control those services and is not responsible for their content, availability, terms, or privacy practices. Review the applicable third-party terms before using an external service.

availability.title: Website availability and modifications
availability.body: TIX may update, suspend, or remove website content or functionality when reasonably necessary, including for maintenance, security, or changes to the studio’s work. Website content is provided as general information and may not always be complete, current, or uninterrupted.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: To the extent permitted by applicable law, TIX is not responsible for indirect loss, loss of data, or loss arising from reliance on general website information or from a third-party service. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded. Any project-specific responsibility is governed by the relevant written agreement.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: TIX may revise these general terms when the website, services, or legal requirements change. The updated version will be posted on this page with a revised review note. Continued use of the website after an update means that you accept the updated general terms.

contact.title: Contact information
contact.body: For questions about these website terms or to discuss a project, contact TIX through the Contact page or email tix@gmail.com. A separate project agreement may be needed before work begins.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes the information the reviewed TIX website receives through its contact flow and how that information may be used to respond to enquiries.

scope.title: Introduction and scope
scope.body: This policy applies to the public TIX website and its contact form. It is based on the website implementation reviewed for this project. A third-party platform linked from the website may have its own privacy notice and practices.

collected.title: Information collected through the website
collected.body: When you browse the site, the application serves page content, images, fonts, and other resources needed to display it. The reviewed application does not include an analytics or advertising integration. Hosting, security, browser, or network providers may process technical request information as part of delivering and protecting a website.

submitted.title: Information voluntarily submitted through the contact form
submitted.body: The form asks for your name, email address, company or project description, and a description of how TIX can help. It also includes a hidden anti-spam field. Please avoid sending passwords, payment details, government identifiers, or other information that is not needed to discuss your enquiry.

use.title: How information is used
use.body: Information submitted through the form is used to understand and respond to your enquiry, communicate about a potential project, and prepare an appropriate discussion or proposal. The form’s email delivery flow uses the submitted email as a reply address so TIX can respond.

sharing.title: Data sharing and service providers
sharing.body: A submitted enquiry may be transmitted to the configured email delivery provider so it can be delivered to TIX. The website also links to social platforms operated by third parties. TIX does not sell contact-form information. The exact providers and operational accounts used for a particular deployment should be confirmed by the business owner.

cookies.title: Cookies and similar technologies
cookies.body: The reviewed application does not intentionally create an application cookie or local browser storage entry for the contact form, and no analytics or advertising script was identified in the repository review. A hosting, security, embedded, or linked third-party service may use its own technologies under its own notice.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.body: The repository does not define a fixed retention period or an automatic deletion workflow for enquiries. TIX should retain information only for as long as reasonably needed to handle the enquiry, maintain appropriate business records, or meet applicable obligations, subject to the business owner’s confirmed practices.

security.title: Data security
security.body: TIX uses reasonable measures available in the website implementation to validate contact submissions and limit malformed requests. No website can guarantee absolute security, and the appropriate handling of submitted information also depends on the configured email provider, accounts, and access controls.

externalServices.title: External links and third-party services
externalServices.body: Links to Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, TikTok, and other external services take you outside the TIX website. Their operators may collect information under their own policies. Check those policies before sharing information with them.

requests.title: Privacy requests and contact method
requests.body: If you have a question about an enquiry you sent through the website, contact TIX at tix@gmail.com or use the Contact page. The website does not currently describe a dedicated automated request portal, identity-verification process, or fixed response period; those details should be confirmed by TIX when a request is received.

updates.title: Policy updates
updates.body: This policy may be updated when the website, its providers, or its information practices change. The current version will be published on this page with an updated review note.

contact.title: Contact information
contact.body: For privacy questions about a website enquiry, contact TIX at tix@gmail.com. Do not send highly sensitive information through an ordinary website enquiry.
